(2) Four hands enter the frame from the top left and right corners, holding tan and white shopping bags. They release a white lace top and a pair of blue denim jeans, which fall onto the heads of the two women. (3) Following a jump cut, the women appear instantly dressed in elaborate denim fashion outfits. The woman on the left wears a blue denim dress with lace trim, and the woman on the right wears a denim crop top and jeans. They strike poses with hands near their faces. (4) They continue posing, now holding luxury-style monogrammed brown handbags. The woman on the right places sunglasses on her head. The lighting remains bright and even throughout the sequence.
